ruleDefinitions.name: Self Extracting Package Creation Via Iexpress.EXE From Potentially Suspicious Location
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects the use of iexpress.exe to create binaries via Self Extraction Directive (SED) files located in potentially suspicious locations.
This behavior has been observed in-the-wild by different threat actors.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\iexpress\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "IEXPRESS\.exe") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/n\\ .*") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\ProgramData\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\Tasks\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Tasks\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\.*")))
